title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East  (Late Show) on 1970-05-15
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > ZA2 > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of the legendary May 15 1970 Fillmore East shows, highlighted by a soaring Dark Star and tight acoustic sets.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is virtually pristine – crisp, bright and only marred by occasional tiny glitches or hiss. Musically the night is a showcase of early‑70 Dead brilliance: two relaxed acoustic sets, stellar New Riders interludes and electric jams that include an unforgettable Dark Star, a thunderous The Other One and a superb Friend of the Devil. Jerry’s guitar (and pedal steel) shines, Phil rolls thunderously on bass, and the band’s banter adds extra charm.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 60 fan reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 5‑stars; recordings are described as excellent with only minor technical hiccups, and musical performance is praised as one of the band’s peak eras.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix, bright mids, tight low end; a few isolated glitches (e.g., St. Stephen tape switch, brief hiss) but overall superb fidelity for an early‑70 SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early acoustic set → New Riders interlude → electric first set → second acoustic set → NRPS again → late electric set; the alternation of folk‑rock and psychedelic jams creates a natural, engaging arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for immaculate guitar tone, soaring solos, vocal delivery and even pedal‑steel work with NRPS.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for a thunderous, rolling bass line especially on The Other One.
band_member_comments.Bob: Banter between songs highlighted as humorous and part of the show’s charm.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s extended drum solo in the first electric set received specific commendation.
